summary: Weave Communications, Inc. disclosed in an 8-K that it is the target of a merger with Willow Parent, LLC and Willow Merger Sub, Inc., affiliates of Francisco Partners. The merger agreement was signed August 18, 2026. A special meeting is scheduled for October 22, 2026, to vote on adopting the merger. As of October 13, 2026, two stockholder complaints and 13 demand letters allege the definitive proxy statement is misleading. The litigation seeks to enjoin the deal or obtain damages. Risk-arb focuses on disclosure-mootness settlements and proxy supplement risk ahead of the vote.
